interpretation: Native hashes are not reproducible across fresh games because six unused Tree-of-Wisdom counters are uninitialised. Only these 24 bytes and their derived CRC are normalised for task76 roof state comparisons; every other state/RNG byte must match.
limitation: Original panel raw state images were not captured, so their native hashes cannot be directly normalised. Fresh paired controls must match all original archived frames/actions/policies and all non-hash outcome fields, then prove full canonical-state equality with probed games. Original hashes remain visible.
